_comment: Editable concept parameters for the 3,000-seat church auditorium coordination model. Units: metres. Every value here is a CONCEPT ASSUMPTION unless the assumptions register says otherwise; none is a verified code, survey or engineering value.

project.name: 3,000-Seat Church Auditorium - Coordination Concept
project.coordinate_system: Local project coordinates. Origin (0,0,0) = intersection of grid A and grid 1 at Level 00 finished floor. +X = along numbered gridlines toward grid H. +Y = toward the platform (grid 12). +Z = up. Project north ASSUMED = +Y; true north unknown (no survey).

omit.reason: Extreme side viewing angle at platform edge; area reused for front wheelchair positions

gable_brace_foot_z._note: grid 3 brace foot is computed: upper-foyer level + 3.5 m (above rear doors / booth window)

zones: Front-of-house lighting / AV rig allowance (below trusses)

egress_placeholders._status: PLACEHOLDER FACTORS FOR CONCEPT FLAGGING ONLY - NOT LOCAL CODE VALUES

balcony_option._note: Option B is a COMPUTED schematic for comparison only - not modelled in Blender/IFC

assumptions: Flat site; external grade = Level 00 (0.000) on all sides
Project north = +Y (towards platform); true north unknown
0.50 m seat centres, 0.60 m chair depth, 0.95 m row pitch (0.35 m clear seatway, seats down)
Common auditorium practice; not checked against local code
Max 14 seats between two aisles (7 to nearest aisle); 10 seats in side blocks
Conventional (non-continental) seating practice; local rule unknown
1.50 m interior aisles ({aisle_straight_clear} m straight clear path with 0.25 m row stagger); wall aisles >= {wall_aisle_min} m to column faces (computed)
Concept allowance; statutory widths depend on occupant load and local code
C-value 0.06 m over row in front AND 0.12 m over the row two in front (staggered seats, 0.25 m offset); focal point 0.6 m above platform front edge; seated eye 1.15 m, wheelchair eye 1.20 m
Typical concept sightline criteria; client/architect to confirm focal point (screens assumed for rear rows)
Platform +0.90 m above front floor, 30 m x 12 m, choir risers 3 tiers (~144 choir seats, excluded from 3,000)
Brief requires large platform/choir; size is a concept allowance
30 wheelchair spaces (approx. 1% of 3,000) each with an adjacent loose companion chair, dispersed front / mid cross-aisle / rear; these are IN ADDITION to the 3,000 fixed congregation seats
Placeholder fraction; local accessibility requirement unknown

5.0 mm/person level routes and doors, 7.5 mm/person stairs used ONLY to flag obvious under-provision; exit loads from a queue-balanced assignment (walk 1.0 m/s, door flow 1.3 p/m/s) and also reported for nearest-exit use
Placeholder; NOT a local code value
Placeholder - must be replaced by local code
Flag within-hall plan travel > 30 m and total plan travel to an external door > 60 m
Placeholder flags only; local limits unknown
Placeholder - must be replaced by local code
Steel roof trusses spanning 50 m between grids B and G at grid lines 3-11 (bay lengths {truss_bays} m); truss depth 1.5 m eaves / 3.5 m ridge (span/14 at ridge)
Concept proportioning rule of thumb; no loads, analysis or member design
Columns 0.6 m (hall) / 0.4 m (other), chords 0.35 m, webs 0.20 m, braces 0.15 m are SPACE-RESERVATION placeholders, not designed sizes

Transverse: truss-to-column portal action (moment knee) supplemented by braced gable bay D-E on grids 3 and 11 (brace feet collected by a horizontal strut into gable posts D/E, which carry to pad footings); longitudinal: vertical X-bracing in end bays 3-4 and 10-11 on grids B and G, inside the cavity of the braced-bay walls; roof-plane bracing in bays 3-4, 7-8 and 10-11; lift enclosure NOT assumed to contribute
Concept scheme only; wind/seismic actions unknown
Pad footing REFERENCE locations under each column (2.4 m / 1.8 m square x 0.6 m, top at -0.90 m) - indicative only
No geotechnical report; bearing capacity unknown
Level 00 = 0.000 finished floor (foyer, front of hall, ambulatory ends, BOH); cross-aisle and upper foyer levels computed by sightline generator
3,000 fixed seats + 30 wheelchair + 30 companion + 200 platform/choir + 30 staff/BOH
Concept tally; legal occupant load to be set by local authority/fire engineer
Two foyer toilet blocks (~65 m2 each) + 4 foyer accessible WCs + BOH accessible WC and staff WCs as SPACE ALLOWANCES; fixture counts not determined
Steel frame, masonry/infill walls and metal roof assumed for space planning only
MEP plant room, roof plant, risers and AV/lighting rig shown as space allowances only
No MEP design at this stage
Option A single-level raked hall selected over Option B floor + balcony for this milestone (see basis_of_design.md comparison)

Wheelchair users on the rear platform / upper foyer (+L02) wait in refuge spaces beside each foyer stair head and are evacuated by assisted means or a designated evacuation lift; refuge enclosure / fire separation not yet designed
No fire strategy yet; required to make upper-level wheelchair spaces workable
Concept assumption - fire engineer to confirm

Rear rake = one transition row off the cross aisle + 2 bands of 10 rows, each band with ONE uniform riser (one riser per row, 0.95 m going); riser changes only at the 2 band boundaries (values in reports/geometry_checks.json)
Concept detailing rule to keep aisle risers uniform; local stair/aisle-step rules unknown
Placeholder material names (steel / concrete / masonry / metal roof - grades TBC) assigned in IFC for quantity take-off structure only
open_issues: Applicable Zimbabwean building, fire, occupancy and accessibility requirements have not been identified; all widths, distances, counts and gradients are unverified.
No site boundary, survey, setbacks, access, parking, contours or orientation. Footprint 59 x 88 m must be tested against an actual site.
No geotechnical report; foundation type, depth and sizes are reference placeholders only.
No loads (dead, live, wind, seismic, rain/ponding), analysis, member design, connection design or deflection/vibration checks. 50 m truss span and lateral system require engineering development.
Exit widths, number of exits, travel distances, aisle widths and stair/ramp capacities are checked only against placeholder factors. Fire engineering / code-based egress design required.

Rear-section aisle steps use ONE uniform riser per band (A-22) but the riser changes at the 2 band boundaries and the going is 0.95 m; nosings, handrails, step lighting and acceptance of the band changes must be resolved in design development.
A single riser between the front-section slope and the cross aisle exists at aisle mouths (value in reports/geometry_checks.json); detail (ramp, step marking, handrail) required.
Ambulatory ramp gradients/landings are generated against placeholder limits; handrails, edge protection and cross-falls not modelled.
No acoustic analysis (reverberation, noise, sound reinforcement) and no screen/AV design; rear-row viewing relies on screens assumption.
No HVAC, electrical, plumbing, drainage, fire detection/suppression, emergency lighting or hydrant design; only space allowances shown.
Toilet fixture counts and layouts not designed; blocks are area allowances.
Glazing, cladding, insulation, rainwater goods and roof drainage not designed.
No cost plan; no budget provided.
On-site water storage/backup power (often needed locally) not allocated - site dependent.
Wall openings are modelled as geometric gaps with IfcOpeningElement voids; door/window types, hardware and fire ratings not assigned. Storeys are height datums (see basis_of_design.md section 6).
Refuge spaces are space allowances on the open upper foyer; protected enclosure, communication, evacuation lift and management plan are not designed.
Travel distance in a 50 m wide hall

Front-section centre seats are ~25 m laterally from any side-wall exit; no central exit is possible in front of the platform. Measured distances exceed the 30 m placeholder flag; options (vomitories under rear rake, narrower/deeper plan, sprinklers/smoke control per local code) need fire-engineering assessment.
